semantics.note: The proposition preserves the entity, regulator, and late-February timing. It does not imply a finding of misconduct.

contract.note: The contract fairly tests whether an investigation existed during the stated period and permits credible contemporaneous reporting with its attribution disclosed.

evidence.note: Reuters contemporaneously reports an active SEC investigation involving OpenAI, attributing the information to the Wall Street Journal. The SEC declined comment; this is reporting, not official confirmation.

reviews.rationale: Reuters' February 29 report, attributed to the Wall Street Journal, describes an ongoing SEC investigation, records requests, and a subpoena to OpenAI. This meets the contract's reporting standard. The absence of official confirmation and of a misconduct finding does not contradict the existence of the investigation.
